messages.subject: f(idx, Z, fixed = T, constr = T)
parts:
Hi, 
What does it mean to add a function "  f(idx, Z, fixed = T, constr = T) " to the model, where " Z " is a known variable.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] f(idx, Z, fixed = T, constr = T)
parts:
if f() is a model component with elements f[1], ... f[n], then adding
f(idx) will add f[idx[1]], f[idx[2]], to the linear predictor. with
f(idx,z), then it will add z[idx[1]]*f[idx[1]], etc, to the linear
predcitor.

'z' is here a constant vector
